title: The Listening Room
alt: Imagined Milan listening café with an oxblood counter, walnut record shelves and a tall industrial window
overview: A former workshop reimagined as a small neighbourhood listening café. The concept brings music, coffee and conversation together through a sequence of intimate spaces rather than one open hall.
approach: An oxblood counter anchors the room. Walnut shelving holds records and absorbs the visual rhythm of the old workshop, while brushed steel adds a lighter note. The retained tall window lends the everyday ritual of gathering a sense of occasion.
